name: Hubei Biocause Heilen Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Hubei Biocause Heilen Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise with diverse operations spanning the pharmaceutical, chemical, and new energy fuel sectors. Within its pharmaceutical segment, the company manufactures active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), various intermediates, and finished drug formulations. Furthermore, its chemical offerings include industrial products such as dimethyl ether gas and chloropropionyl chloride. The firm is headquartered in Jingmen, China.
